crossRefs.note: “Moreover you know also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, even what he did to the two captains of the armies of…
Do therefore according to your wisdom, and don’t let his gray head go down to Sheol in peace.
This news came to Joab; for Joab had followed Adonijah, although he didn’t follow Absalom. Joab fled to Yahweh’s Tent…

translations.web: then the elders of his city shall send and bring him there, and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, that he may die.
translations.bsb: the elders of his city must send for him, bring him back, and hand him over to the avenger of blood to die.
translations.kjv: Then the elders of his city shall send and fetch him thence, and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, that he may die.
translations.asv: then the elders of his city shall send and fetch him thence, and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, that he may die.
